name: dsh-plugins
description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) local plugin collection — central management and distribution of custom DSH plugins. Includes dsh-tool-oss (multi-bucket OSS object-storage file browser with upload and recursive deletion, compatible with SiliconFlow, Tencent Cloud COS, Alibaba Cloud OSS) and dsh-ui-archived-local (archived sidebar panel with view/open/unarchive/delete and custom confirmation modals).
